purpose: Teach: 吹か/絵柄/被る/亡き/女将/桶/安物/小豆

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「窓から風を吹かれて気持ちいい」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of the customers was saying how lovely it felt with the breeze blowing in from the window.
lines.style: Soft, dreamy opening on her friend's name. Gentle lilt while quoting, a small smile audible underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、和菓子の絵柄、つまり繊細な絵柄をお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And a customer complimented the design on the wagashi, Mei — that delicate little pattern, you know.
lines.style: Warm, melodic delivery. Slight lift of pride on the compliment, unhurried service-counter softness throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「災難を被る前に予防策を」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Another customer said, 'Better to take precautions before disaster strikes.' Sounded like advice worth keeping.
lines.style: Slightly hushed, thoughtful pace. The quoted line delivered carefully, like repeating borrowed wisdom she wants to remember.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、亡き先代のオーナーの写真を見て涙されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of them teared up looking at the photo of our late former owner, Mei.
lines.style: Voice drops soft and low. Slow, tender pace with a small catch of feeling before the friend's name.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の女将さんとよく来店されるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, that customer often comes in with her friend — the innkeeper lady, the okami-san.
lines.style: Brightening a little after the sad note. Light, chatty warmth, a fond emphasis on the okami-san.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お風呂の桶のお話を笑顔で語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she told us this whole story about a bath bucket, grinning the entire time, Mei.
lines.style: Amused warmth bubbling under the words. Slightly quicker pace, a soft laugh escaping near the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「安物でも丁寧に使えば長持ち」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She also said, 'Even cheap things last a long time if you treat them with care.'
lines.style: Gentle, appreciative delivery. Slows on the quote, savoring it, with a soft approving hum in the tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、小豆のおはぎがお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and apparently the adzuki ohagi is her absolute favorite, Mei.
lines.style: Bright, rounded-off close. A pleased little rise on 'favorite,' settling into a cozy, satisfied ending.
